message:
The other day, we found ourselves in the midst of an unexpected storm warning. It wasn’t a huge deal, but it did remind us of the importance of being prepared, even in little ways. We grabbed our go-bags, which we’d assembled during a quiet afternoon a few months back, and found them to be a source of calm amid the chaos. 🌧️ Inside, we had our water, snacks, and even a few comforting items like a favorite book. It felt like a small win that made a big difference in our mindset. 

Have you had a moment where your prep work paid off? We’d love to hear your tips!
